minimax/h3/text-to-video.description: H3 at the standard tier, up to fifteen seconds a shot. Here, from a sentence.

pricing.note: fal publishes $0.05 per second of output at 480P, $0.06 at 768P, $0.13 at 2K and $0.16 at 4K. Priced from the 2K default. genmedia reports $0.00017 per compute second, which is not what a request is charged.
